name: OneTrust
description: OneTrust is a trust, privacy, consent, data governance, risk, compliance, and third-party management platform. Organizations use it to manage privacy operations, website consent, governance, risk, and regulatory workflows.
agentUseSummary: Connect one OneTrust tenant with customer-owned client credentials, one selected CMP domain, and one selected scan. Agents can confirm selected-domain branding-resource availability and inspect an aggregate scan summary; branding content, private trust data, detailed findings, lists, other resources, exports, and all mutations are blocked.

credentialRequirements.name: ONETRUST_TENANT_HOST
credentialRequirements.label: OneTrust tenant hostname
credentialRequirements.helpText: The exact customer tenant hostname ending in onetrust.com, without scheme or path.

credentialRequirements.name: ONETRUST_CLIENT_ID
credentialRequirements.label: OneTrust client ID
credentialRequirements.helpText: A customer-owned OAuth client credential limited to the required Cookie Compliance read scopes.

credentialRequirements.name: ONETRUST_CLIENT_SECRET
credentialRequirements.label: OneTrust client secret
credentialRequirements.helpText: Relay encrypts this customer secret and exchanges it server-side for short-lived access tokens.

credentialRequirements.name: ONETRUST_DOMAIN_ID
credentialRequirements.label: Selected OneTrust domain ID
credentialRequirements.helpText: The one UUID-form CMP domain Relay may inspect.

credentialRequirements.name: ONETRUST_SCAN_ID
credentialRequirements.label: Selected OneTrust scan ID
credentialRequirements.helpText: The one UUID-form domain scan whose aggregate summary Relay may inspect.

capabilities.label: Read domain branding availability
capabilities.description: Confirm branding attributes are available for one selected CMP domain without exposing their content.

capabilities.label: Read selected scan summary
capabilities.description: Read aggregate lifecycle and finding counts for one selected domain scan.

allowed.label: Read domain branding availability
allowed.description: Confirm the branding-attributes resource is available for one selected OneTrust CMP domain without exposing its content.

allowed.label: Read selected scan summary
allowed.description: Read aggregate finding counts and lifecycle metadata for one selected domain scan.

blocked.label: Expose private trust data
blocked.description: Client secrets, tokens, data subjects, identifiers, consent records, preferences, cookie details, scripts, HTML/CSS, vendors, forms, tags, credentials, and attachments are excluded.

blocked.label: Mutate OneTrust state
blocked.description: Publishing, scanning, categorization, domains, banners, preferences, consent, organizations, users, risk, governance, exports, and administration are blocked.

blocked.label: Use broad OneTrust access
blocked.description: Other tenants, domains, scans, child organizations, list endpoints, paging, arbitrary queries, raw APIs, redirects, downloads, and bulk export are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Read Only
approvalProfiles.description: Read two selected-domain metadata summaries; private data and all mutations remain blocked.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway attaches encrypted customer credentials server-side and mounts exactly two selected-domain metadata reads.
Railway attaches encrypted customer credentials server-side and mounts exactly two selected-domain metadata reads.

providerSetup.blocker: A OneTrust tenant, scope-limited client credential, staging CMP domain, and completed staging scan are required. No authorized tenant or credentials are available in this worker lane.
providerSetup.nextAction: An authorized OneTrust administrator must create a least-privilege client credential, connect the exact tenant/domain/scan through Relay, and validate both projections, redaction, replacement, disconnect, post-disconnect denial, and scope failure in Fairfax before live use.
